requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles with 6,000-page yield for black and CMY, with CMY bottle size supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user convenience, reduce refill frequency, and support high-volume printing segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new tank design and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New NGB bottles are available with specified yields, tested for compatibility and reliability in Magellan printers.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure the new ink bottles and tank system provide spill-free reliability during refilling and normal operation.
requirements.Rationale: To prevent mess, improve user experience, and reduce service costs due to ink spills.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage occurs during normal use and refilling as verified by testing and user trials.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Non-Ozone Air Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining current click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances filtration, ensures product differentiation, and maintains user familiarity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design update and compatibility with existing assembly processes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F implemented with metal foiled labyrinth, lid label, and verified fit/function in assembly.

requirements.Title: Reuse SuperAmp Si PHA
requirements.Description: Reuse the SuperAmp Si PHA (Printhead Assembly) from previous models in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages proven technology, reduces development time and costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new system architecture.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp Si PHA is integrated and passes all functional and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi/Nessie Inks without Reformulation
requirements.Description: Continue using Magi and Nessie pigment inks without any reformulation for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures ink quality, reduces R&D effort, and maintains supply chain efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink compatibility with new bottle and tank system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Magi/Nessie inks function as required in Magellan printers without reformulation.

requirements.Title: Comprehensive Reliability and Performance Modelling
requirements.Description: Model and characterize reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, IDS (Ink Delivery System), including startup and NOA-F End-of-Life.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust performance, predict maintenance needs, and optimize lifetime costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires access to component data and simulation tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reliability and performance models are completed and validated against prototype data.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling for Tank and PQ Impact
requirements.Description: Conduct ink stability modelling for tank storage and assess its impact on Print Quality (PQ).
requirements.Rationale: To maintain print quality over time and prevent ink degradation issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires collaboration with ink suppliers and tank design team.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability models are validated and PQ is maintained throughout expected tank life.

requirements.Title: Support for Services/Contractual Use Cases
requirements.Description: Ensure the product supports services and contractual use cases, including NOA-F as service parts for in-warranty support.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and supports business models reliant on service contracts.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires logistics and parts supply alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service parts are available and processes documented for in-warranty service.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 Integration on Lid
requirements.Description: Integrate Acumen 6 technology on the lid of the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Likely for enhanced authentication, tracking, or user interface (exact function to be confirmed).
requirements.Dependencies: Requires lid design update and electronics integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is present and functional on the printer lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration Updates for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA 14 factory line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cart and labelling tool in Orcus 5 factory. Mold for 1 to 4 new keyed caps.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures manufacturing readiness for new components and configurations.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on finalized design of NOA-F, ink cart, and keyed caps.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Factory lines are updated and validated for new components.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design PHA and NOA-F to be customer-replaceable for ease of maintenance and reduced service calls.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces total cost of ownership.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for tool-less or simple replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PHA and NOA-F can be replaced by customers as per user manual, verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: Support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product reliability and appeal for high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires component durability and reliability validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer maintains functional performance for at least 80,000 pages under standard usage.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Support
requirements.Description: Provide SKU 2 with high throughput and Page Description Language (PDL) support for Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) model.
requirements.Rationale: Supports flexible business models and enterprise customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with PaaS platforms and PDL support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 available with PaaS and PDL features enabled.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Tank Size Increase
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington ID with increased tank size, no change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher ink capacity without major redesign of ADF.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires tank and chassis redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tank size increased and integrated with Reddington ID, verified in prototype builds.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Use EPS foam for printer packaging to enhance protection during shipping.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage in transit and improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Packaging supplier capability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging passes drop and vibration tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance
requirements.Description: Ensure printer meets EPEAT3 and LOT4 environmental requirements, and Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Supports sustainability goals and enables sales in regulated markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design and documentation to meet certification standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel (PDL SKU).

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Alignment with Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with the protruding tank design and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures usability and compact form factor despite larger tank.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on final tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function properly and do not interfere with tank, verified in user testing.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) into the printer UI.
requirements.Rationale: Improves usability and user interface experience.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires electronics and UI design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD display is functional and passes usability tests.

requirements.Title: Four-Tube Platform with Sayan Sibstar Tubes and New Routing
requirements.Description: Leverage four-tube platform using Sayan Sibstar tubes, implement new tube routing and integration.
requirements.Rationale: Supports reliable ink delivery and maintains print quality.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube and tank design, routing feasibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Four-tube system is implemented and validated for flow and reliability.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station for improved aerosol management due to changes in tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains printer reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on tank and service station design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within safe limits during operation, verified by testing.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Modelling
requirements.Description: Model carriage dynamics and force with new tube and increased weight configuration.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable movement and prevents mechanical failures.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updated mechanical models and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates reliably under all expected loads, validated by testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Update paper path design to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: Reduces wear and maintains performance over longer warranty life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires materials and mechanical updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path maintains function and quality for 80,000 pages, verified by durability testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance as a serviceable part, replaceable at service centers after 80,000-page life.
requirements.Rationale: Extends overall printer lifespan and supports high-volume users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design for serviceability and part supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part can be replaced by service centers, documented in service manuals.

requirements.Title: New Make-Break and FI Connection for IDS
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection for the Ink Delivery System (IDS).
requirements.Rationale: Enables easy assembly and reliable ink delivery.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New connections are implemented and pass reliability/assembly tests.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-Tank with Increased Size, Keying, and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank with increased size, new keying, and LOI SHAID integration.
requirements.Rationale: Improves ink security, compatibility, and capacity.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires tank and keying design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI tank implemented with increased size, keying, and SHAID, validated in testing.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new startup algorithm and air management system for the IDS.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printer startup and prevents air bubble issues.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on IDS design and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup and air management algorithms implemented and validated by startup success rate.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Implement new algorithms for servicing and startup to optimize performance and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and reduces service incidents.
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware and system integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Algorithms deployed and verified to improve servicing/startup KPIs.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to align with page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent output quality and transparent yield for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires test development and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics are met in product validation.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages existing, proven electronics to reduce development cost and risk.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with new system design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All components function as required in Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: Enables modern connectivity features for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module works reliably in all supported use cases.

requirements.Title: Firmware Dune
requirements.Description: Deploy Dune firmware for the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Leverages existing firmware platform for faster time-to-market.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires adaptation to Magellan hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Firmware is stable and passes all functional and regression tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx hardware and firmware security features in the Magellan printer.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures device and data security for end users and enterprise customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and firmware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Security features implemented and pass penetration testing.

requirements.Title: Business Model and Solution Support
requirements.Description: Support Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise business models, including PaaS, WorkFromHome, Flexworker, and onboarding paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP).
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and supports diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP and partner solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business models and onboarding paths are functional and documented.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution, SMB Manageability, Enterprise Support
requirements.Description: Integrate scan solution, SMB manageability, and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM) into the product.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product value for business customers and IT departments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software and solution integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All solutions are available and functional in Magellan printers.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers Support
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility and ease of deployment for IT administrators and end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires driver and software validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers are supported and pass compatibility testing.

requirements.Title: Schedule Adherence (Q325-Q427)
requirements.Description: Meet the defined schedule checkpoints for hardware, NOA-F, and bottle development.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for timely market launch and business objectives.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on project management and supply chain execution.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints are met as per schedule, with documentation.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and HP Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Design features and pricing to protect HP’s micro/SMB market segments and prevent profit pool erosion to competitors.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains HP’s market share and financial health.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires market analysis and competitive benchmarking.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market share and profit pool are maintained or improved post-launch.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet, Flank with PDL in Medium/Enterprise
requirements.Description: Strategically position LaserJet as primary and PDL as secondary offering in medium and enterprise segments to win over competitors as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: Improves competitive positioning against Epson and others.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires product positioning and sales enablement alignment.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Market positioning materials developed and sales teams trained.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS offering to new profitable segments to increase HP’s market share.
requirements.Rationale: Drives revenue growth and leverages CISS technology advantages.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires market segmentation and product adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS share increases in targeted segments post-launch.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform and Marconi-Hi Product
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Watt-LE mechanical platform and Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID) for Magellan development.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost, risk, and accelerates time to market.
requirements.Dependencies: Compatibility with Magellan requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Platform leveraged and integrated into Magellan system.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks as a system.
requirements.Rationale: Delivers a cohesive, high-performing ink delivery and filtration solution.
requirements.Dependencies: System integration and validation required.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System integration complete and validated by system testing.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K (Constrained)
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp PHA life is at least 65,000 pages (non-negotiable constraint).
requirements.Rationale: Critical for product reliability and service cost targets.
requirements.Dependencies: Component reliability and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65,000-page life testing.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years (Optimized)
requirements.Description: Design to achieve a 2-year warranty life for the printer.
requirements.Rationale: Meets customer and market expectations for product longevity.
requirements.Dependencies: Component and system durability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes 2-year accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 ppm (PDL)
requirements.Description: Achieve print throughput of 25 ppm (pages per minute) and 20 ppm for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and market needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine and firmware performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Design for easy serviceability, including a maintenance box for consumables or waste.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design of maintenance box and access features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is easily accessible and replaceable, verified in usability testing.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize features and solutions to meet the needs of SMB (Small and Medium Business) customers.
requirements.Rationale: Increases product appeal and competitiveness in the SMB segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Market research and feature prioritization.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB-specific features are implemented and validated with target customers.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Provide optional support for 12,000-page yield CMYK ink bottles (flexible priority).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses high-volume customer needs and competitive differentiation.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink and tank design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 12K-CMYK bottles available and compatible with Magellan printers.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K (Flexible)
requirements.Description: Allow for trade-off with a 6,000-page yield option (flexible priority).
requirements.Rationale: Provides SKU variety for different market segments.
requirements.Dependencies: SKU planning and inventory management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 6K trade page SKU available in product lineup.
